source: Kaggle: Netflix Movies and TV Shows (shivamb/netflix-shows), netflix_titles.csv
sampling_method: Full actor co-appearance graph: one Person node per distinct actor across all titles' cast lists, one ACTED_WITH edge per pair of actors sharing a title (multigraph, not deduplicated across titles unless --dedupe-edges was passed). No down-sampling applied -- the full graph already falls within the assignment's 100k-500k relationship band.
